changePolicy: Do not remove modules merely because they are not reachable from these runtime entrypoints; CLI and research are legitimate consumers.
Before wiring research into a runtime lane, review the input/output contract, EARLY freeze, missingness, provenance and unseen validation; update this inventory in the same PR.
Production activation, deployments, storage migration and model promotion are separate decisions.
